newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai central bank ready to help out Finance One.
newsitem.headline: Thai central bank ready to help out Finance One.

text.p: Thailand's central bank said on Monday that it had enough funds and was ready to help ailing finance firm Finance One Plc raise capital if the company could not do so from existing shareholders.

Finance One, whose planned merger with Thai Danu Bank Plc failed last Friday, was ordered after the news broke to raise capital by 8.28 billion baht ($318 million) through a two-for-one rights issue at 7.50 baht per share.
Bank of Thailand Governor Rerngchai Marakanond told reporters that central bank funds could be used to help the company if its existing shareholders did not take the proposed rights issue.
